title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Liquid Web / StellarWP Gutenberg Blocks by Kadence Blocks, allowing improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This vulnerability affects versions up to 3.9.1 and enables code injection via crafted input. The issue is classified as CWE-80 and has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.3.
